timestamp.description: When the event occurred or was recorded.

event_type.description: What kind of event this is: an action name, event code or message class. Custom application codes belong here.

outcome.description: Whether the event succeeded or failed: success/failure, allow/deny, a status or result code.

severity.description: Log level or priority: INFO, WARN, ERROR, a syslog severity number.

actor_identity.description: The user, account, service principal or subject that caused the event.

source_component.description: The program, service, module or process name that generated the record.

host.description: The host, node or device the record was generated on.

source_address.description: Network address the event originated from: an IP address or hostname, without a port.

destination_address.description: Network address the event was directed at: an IP address or hostname, without a port.

target_object.description: The resource acted on: a file, URL path, table, record id or object name.

session_id.description: Session, request, trace or correlation identifier linking related records.

event_id.description: Unique identifier or sequence number of this individual record.

process_id.description: Operating system process or thread id.

constraints.timezone_required: boolean; timestamp values must carry a UTC offset or zone designator
constraints.min_precision: one of second, millisecond, microsecond; minimum timestamp resolution
constraints.allowed_values: list of strings; the element's value must be one of these

requirements.summary: Every record carries a timestamp with a UTC offset and at least millisecond precision.
requirements.quote: Each log entry shall include a timestamp with a UTC offset and at least millisecond resolution.

requirements.summary: Every record names the component that produced it and the type of event.
requirements.quote: Each log entry shall identify the originating component and the event type.

requirements.summary: Every record identifies the acting user and the outcome of the action.
requirements.quote: Each log entry shall record the identity of the actor and the outcome of the action.

requirements.summary: Records of network-originated events carry the source address.
requirements.quote: Entries for network-originated events should include the source address.

requirements.summary: Records must not contain passwords or session secrets.
requirements.quote: Log entries shall not contain passwords, tokens or other authentication secrets.
requirements.unmapped_reason: a prohibition on content; no catalogue element expresses the absence of secrets

requirements.summary: Logs are retained for at least twelve months.
requirements.quote: Log data shall be retained for a minimum of twelve months.

requirements.summary: Access to logs is restricted to authorised staff.
requirements.quote: Access to log data shall be limited to authorised personnel.
